# Erdos.p1095 — Erdős problem 1095

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/1095
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/1095.lean`, theorem `erdos_1095.variants.upper_conjecture`, AMS 11).

Ecklund, Erdős, and Selfridge [EES74] conjectured $g(k)\leq \exp((1+o(1))k)$.

## Statement
∃ f : ℕ → ℝ, Tendsto f atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ ∀ᶠ k in atTop, g k ≤ exp (k * (1 + f k))

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
